source(output(
		deliveryMethodConfigId as integer,
		ntid as string,
		fileFormatConfigId as integer,
		reportId as integer,
		reportName as string,
		deliveryLocation as string,
		reportNetworkLocation as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Declare @time varchar(20) Declare @hour int Declare @minutes int Declare @meridian varchar(20)  SELECT  @hour = FORMAT(getdate(),\'hh\') SELECT  @minutes = FORMAT(GETDATE(),\'mm\') SELECT @meridian=FORMAT(GETDATE(),\'tt\')   IF (@minutes >= 30)        SET @time = cast(@hour as varchar(10)) + \':30 \' + @meridian   ELSE        SET @time = cast(@hour as varchar(10)) + \':00 \' + @meridian     SELECT  a.reportId ,a.reportName ,a.deliveryLocation ,a.reportNetworkLocation ,a.fileFormatConfigId ,a.deliveryMethodConfigId ,a.fileFormatConfigName ,a.deliveryMethodConfigName ,a.reportScheduleId ,a.startDate ,a.endDate ,a.frequency ,a.frequencyConfigName ,a.timeslot ,a.timeslotConfigName ,a.ntid,b.[reportCatConfigId] FROM Report.vwCraReportSchedule a join [Report].[Report] b on a.reportid=b.reportid where GETDATE() BETWEEN startDate AND endDate  and frequencyconfigName LIKE \'%\' + FORMAT(GETDATE(),\'dddd\') + \'%\'  and timeslotconfigName LIKE \'%\' +@time +\'%\' and b.[reportCatConfigId]=631',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GetScheduledReports

		deliveryMethodConfigId as integer,
		ntid as string,
		fileFormatConfigId as integer,

		reportName as string,
		deliveryLocation as string,
		reportNetworkLocation as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		deliveryMethodConfigId,
		ntid,
		fileFormatConfigId,
		reportId,
		reportName,
		deliveryLocation,
		reportNetworkLocation)) ~> OutputPlaceHolderRecordsetDestination
